Default plot styling options

Source: R/plot-options.R
plot_default_options.Rd

The built-in defaults for plot_options(), before any global customization. Useful for resetting after calling plot_options(), or as a base to build a custom style set from with utils::modifyList().

Usage

plot_default_options()

Value

A list with node_style, edge_style, label_style, and title_style components - see plot.cgraph() for their fields.

See also

plot_options() for getting and setting these globally.

Other plotting: cgraph_layout(), plot.cgraph(), plot_options()

Examples

plot_default_options()
#> $node_style
#> $node_style$fill
#> [1] "white"
#> 
#> $node_style$col
#> [1] "black"
#> 
#> $node_style$lwd
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $node_style$padding
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $node_style$size
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $node_style$shape
#> [1] "circle"
#> 
#> 
#> $edge_style
#> $edge_style$col
#> [1] "black"
#> 
#> $edge_style$lwd
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $edge_style$arrow_size
#> [1] 3
#> 
#> $edge_style$circle_size
#> [1] 1.5
#> 
#> $edge_style$gap
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $edge_style$label_col
#> [1] "black"
#> 
#> $edge_style$label_fontsize
#> [1] 9
#> 
#> $edge_style$label_shift
#> [1] 0.5
#> 
#> 
#> $label_style
#> $label_style$col
#> [1] "black"
#> 
#> $label_style$fontsize
#> [1] 10
#> 
#> 
#> $title_style
#> $title_style$col
#> [1] "black"
#> 
#> $title_style$fontsize
#> [1] 14
#> 
#> $title_style$fontface
#> [1] "bold"
#> 
#> 

# Reset to defaults after changing them
plot_options(plot_default_options())
